verses.gurmukhi: ਸਕਲ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਿਖੈ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਦੀਰਘ ਦੁਇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਭਏ ਬੂਡੇ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਡਾਈ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sakal banaasapatee bikhai dhrum dheeragh dhui nihafal bhe boodde bahut baddaiee kai ||

en.bdb: Amongst all the vegetation, both Silk cotton (Simhal) and Bamboo are the tallest but feeling proud of their size and greatness, they remain failures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੇਂਬਲ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਾਂਸ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਬਹੁ ਗਾਂਠਨ ਢਿਠਾਈ ਕੈ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan subaasanaa kai se(n)bal subaas hot baa(n)s niraga(n)dh bahu gaa(n)Than ddiThaiee kai||

en.bdb: At least a Silk cotton tree do acquire some fragrance from a Sandalwood tree but due to the obstinacy of the knots, a Bamboo tree remains bereft of Sandalwood smell.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਂਬਲ ਕੇ ਫਲ ਤੂਲ ਖਗ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਛਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਤਉ ਬਰਨ ਦੋਖੀ ਜਾਰਤ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: se(n)bal ke fal tool khag mirag chhaiaa taa kai baa(n)s tau baran dhokhee jaarat buraiee kai ||

en.bdb: The cotton of the Silk cotton tree is put to use. The vast expanse of the tree provides shade for birds and other animals, but a Bamboo is family destroyer and due to its evil nature, it burns the other Bamboos that it rubs with.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਹੋਤ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਿ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਕੈ ॥੩੦੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh saadh hot saadh sa(n)gat kai tirasaTai na gur gop dhroh gur bhaiee kai ||307||

en.bdb: Similarly an apostate Sikh becomes an obedient of the Guru by obtaining his sermons and enjoying the company of godly persons. But one who turns his face despite belonging to Guru, who is guilty of doing wrong to his Guru-brothers pushed around from door to door.(307)
